description: Rent index per Swiss canton: BFS average rent of occupied rented flats (structural survey, existing rents, not asking rents) by canton and number of rooms with the 95% confidence interval, 2010 onwards, plus a size-standardised rent (DERIVED by Swiss Living Index: each canton weighted with one fixed Swiss mix of dwellings by rooms) as a level index (Switzerland = 100) and change index (first year = 100), growth over 5 years and since 2010, vacancy rate and the national CPI rent index. With canton: its full yearly series; without: all cantons ranked. Also the rent statistics Basel-Stadt (quarterly rent index, year-on-year), Geneva (rent index since 1995 and average rent by rooms; Geneva counts the kitchen as a room) and the city of Zurich (median and mean net rent for 2, 3 and 4 rooms, non-profit vs other, every two years) publish themselves, each with its own definition and licence.
name: rent_index
